IncidentCategoryCustomerFriendlyDescript: We regularly inspect trees near overhead power lines to keep your electricity supply safe and reliable. A recent inspection found some trees have grown too close to power lines. If unmanaged, branches could touch the overhead lines and cause unexpected interruptions to your electricity supply. This work will allow us to also raise the height of a overhead cable to ensure it is at statutory height. We need to trim these trees and raise the height of a cable, which requires a temporary power cut because the work cannot be done safely while electricity lines are live. This essential work involves approximately 300 metres of tree cutting across 60 sections of the overhead electricity network. We appreciate your area has been impacted with unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. This work is taking place along Firmingers Road and Well Hill. A road closure will be in place to allow the works to be completed safely.

IncidentCategoryCustomerFriendlyDescript: We regularly inspect trees near overhead power lines to keep your electricity supply safe and reliable. A recent inspection found some trees have grown too close to power lines. If unmanaged, branches could touch the overhead lines and cause further unexpected interruptions to your electricity supply as we appreciate some customers may have experienced unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months because of these trees. We also appreciate some customers may have experienced a planned power cut in the last 6 months. We need to trim these trees, which requires a temporary power cut because the work cannot be done safely while electricity lines are live. This essential work involves approximately 400 metres of tree cutting across 5 sections of the overhead electricity network. This work is taking place in the Lower Road area.
